title: DPA: Decentralized Primal Averaging with Quasi-Global Momentum for Highly Heterogeneous Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.16871v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decentralized training of deep learning models keeps training data local and supports on-device learning over networks. In realistic scenarios, heterogeneity across agents' local data poses an optimization challenge and can severely degrade test accuracy, especially on sparse communication graphs. Building on recent advances in centralized primal averaging, we propose Decentralized Primal Averaging (DPA), a decentralized learning algorithm that combines primal averaging with a local quasi-global momentum buffer. DPA maintains three coupled sequences for optimization, gradient evaluation, and output averaging, while using consecutive mixed iterates to construct a network-aware momentum direction without transmitting an auxiliary tracking variable. translated_title: DPA：面向高度异构数据的具有准全局动量的去中心化原始平均算法
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型的去中心化训练能够将训练数据保留在本地，并支持跨网络的设备端学习。在现实场景中，各代理本地数据之间的异构性带来了优化上的挑战，可能严重降低测试精度，尤其是在稀疏通信图上。基于集中式原始平均的最新进展，我们提出了去中心化原始平均，这是一种将原始平均与本地准全局动量缓冲区相结合的去中心化学习算法。DPA 维护三个相互耦合的序列，分别用于优化、梯度评估和输出平均，同时利用连续的混合迭代点构建具有网络感知能力的动量方向，而无需传输辅助跟踪变量。对于光滑非凸目标函数，我们为 DPA 建立了收敛界，并给出了在足够多的迭代次数下随代理数量实现线性加速的条件。我们还引入了……
tldr: 该论文提出去中心化原始平均算法DPA，通过本地准全局动量缓冲区在无需传输辅助跟踪变量的情况下构建网络感知的动量方向，有效应对高度异构数据下的去中心化训练难题，并建立了收敛界与随代理数量线性加速的条件。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Decentralized Primal Averaging (DPA), which combines primal averaging with a local quasi-global momentum buffer to construct a network-aware momentum direction without transmitting auxiliary tracking variables, tackling highly heterogeneous data in decentralized training with proven convergence and linear speedup guarantees.
